title: Setup docs and todo list name steps not needed
what: Fix the docs/setup.md bullets and the --relay-folder note; flag the empty principles at the end of setup; skip the bin/wt TODO when nothing needs preparing; relay gate help names bin/ci and the committed .relay/checks/<sha>.gate.log.
why: docs/setup.md lists the setup writes without .relay/ and never says --relay-folder does nothing after plain setup; setup leaves a bin/wt worktree-prep TODO that a pure-Python project does not need, leaves CLAUDE.md principles and openspec/config.yaml empty (a reviewer had no promise to check against); relay gate --help prints only its usage line, not that it runs bin/ci and commits the log.
failing_case: Trial: the reviewer noted CLAUDE.md principles are TODO; relay setup --relay-folder after setup printed 'nothing changed'; relay gate committed its own log to the branch, moving the head.
pass_cases: docs/setup.md matches what setup writes; relay gate --help names bin/ci and the committed log.
